group_members_user_unique.name: group_members_user_unique
group_members_user_unique.where: "group_members"."user_id" is not null and "group_members"."removed_at" is null

groups_dates_order.name: groups_dates_order
groups_dates_order.value: "groups"."starts_on" is null or "groups"."ends_on" is null or "groups"."ends_on" >= "groups"."starts_on"

transactions_recurring_draft_unique.name: transactions_recurring_draft_unique
transactions_recurring_draft_unique.where: "transactions"."status" = 'draft' and "transactions"."deleted_at" is null and "transactions"."recurring_item_id" is not null

transactions_group_mirror_unique.name: transactions_group_mirror_unique
transactions_group_mirror_unique.where: "transactions"."group_expense_id" is not null and "transactions"."deleted_at" is null

transactions_settlement_mirror_unique.name: transactions_settlement_mirror_unique
transactions_settlement_mirror_unique.where: "transactions"."settlement_id" is not null and "transactions"."deleted_at" is null

transactions_mirror_source.name: transactions_mirror_source
transactions_mirror_source.value: ("transactions"."group_expense_id" is null or "transactions"."source" = 'group') and ("transactions"."settlement_id" is null or "transactions"."source" = 'settlement')
